reason: A Settings web plugin that monitors DeepSeek Harness versions, compares them with npm releases, notifies users about updates, and optionally runs the DSH update command.

summaries.zh: 在设置页检查 DeepSeek Harness 版本、展示 npm 发布信息、发送更新通知，并支持用户一键运行更新命令。
summaries.en: A Settings web plugin that checks DeepSeek Harness versions against npm releases, provides update notifications, and lets users run the update command.

capabilities: Reads the local DSH version by running dsh --version
Queries npm registry version information for @deepseek-ai/dsh
Runs npx to install the latest DSH version when initiated by the user
Writes check history to a file under ~/.dsh
Displays live update output in the web interface
Sends browser system notifications for detected updates
